title: The Telangana Excise Act, 1968.
full_text: The Telangana Excise Act, 1968. Rules Regulations Notifications Orders Circulars Ordinance Statutes SectionsScheduleAnnexureAppendixFormsActdetails Act ID: 196817 Act Number: 17 Enactment Date: 1968-08-26 Act Year: 1968 Short Title: The Telangana Excise Act, 1968. Long Title: An Act to consolidate and amend the law relating to the production, manufacture, possession, transport, purchase and sale of intoxicating liquor and drugs, the levy of duties of excise and countervailing duties on alcoholic liquors for human consumption and opium, Indian hemp and other narcotic drugs and narcotics and to provide for matters connected therewith in the State of Telangana.
